findings.title: Release retries can invalidate a seal's provider hold before commit
findings.detail: PARTIALLY_FIXED. SealRevision now places generation-conditioned holds and seals their records transactionally (packages/application/src/sources/handlers/seal-revision.ts:134 and :255). The regression at apps/api/test/cmd017-seal-revision.test.ts:314 covers both previously identified replacement orderings and passes at verify.log:736. However, requestRelease returns RELEASE for every stale RELEASING row without claiming or renewing the retry. Multiple callers can therefore issue releases for the same generation. recordRelease at holds.ts:162 marks all releasing rows RELEASED after one answer, allowing a new intent at :92 while another release remains outstanding. apps/control/src/storage-work.ts:96 invokes the provider outside that transaction. The generation-only release contract has no hold-incarnation fence; the fake clears the flag at packages/application/src/testing/contract-fake-object-storage.ts:528. A delayed older release can consequently remove the new seal's hold, allowing replacement before its commit. An in-memory probe using the existing compiled fake confirmed RELEASED, subsequent HELD, delayed RELEASED, then successful overwrite. The complete database interleaving was established by code inspection, not executed.
findings.reproduction: Leave a failed seal's cleanup RELEASING by making releaseHold fail, with the file still admitted and revision READY_TO_SEAL. After the 900-second retry bound, run two releaseObjectHolds calls. Pause the first at storage.holdNext('releaseHold'); the second also receives RELEASE because holds.ts:149 does not claim the retry. Let the second release and record RELEASED. Retry SealRevision and pause it at journal.commit after its new provider hold. Resume the first release, overwrite the accepted object, then resume the seal. The old release clears the new hold on the same generation; the seal commits its cached held generation without a provider fence against that release.

findings.title: Per-association counts remain preserved through evaluation and sealing
findings.detail: FIXED. tablesWithAssociations still validates and attaches measured association counts; lines 120 and 144 persist and hash them. SealRevision validates their completeness, uniqueness and sum at packages/application/src/sources/handlers/seal-revision.ts:491. The integrated regression at apps/control/test/end-to-end.test.ts:199 checks independently calculated persisted and sealed counts at lines 260–264. verify.log:640 records its pass.
findings.reproduction: The two-association selection passes through SelectInputTables, the real evaluation consumer and SealRevision, preserving distinct WORKS_AT and OWNED_BY counts.

findings.title: Excluded hidden columns remain excluded from projection counts
findings.detail: FIXED. Only counted cells enter the projection lookup; lines 215–217 reject projection references to excluded hidden columns. The regression at packages/data-plane/test/selection-evaluation.test.ts:371 retains hidden-key, hidden-field, formula-policy and visible-column controls. verify.log:616 records its pass.
findings.reproduction: Projecting an excluded hidden column fails PROJECTION_COLUMN_HIDDEN. Including it applies the formula policy, while the visible-column positive control succeeds.

findings.title: Lapsed unresolved cancellation secrets remain discoverable and purged
findings.detail: FIXED. The separate agency-paged discovery still finds lapsed cancellation secrets and invokes cleanup at line 66. apps/control/src/storage-work.ts:214–216 purges the secret after the horizon without changing uncertainty into confirmation or calling the provider. The regression at apps/control/test/storage-lifecycle.test.ts:295 covers expiry, retained UNCERTAIN status, no additional provider call and pagination past cleaned agencies. verify.log:661 records its pass.
findings.reproduction: An unresolved cancellation retains its secret before expiry, loses it on the post-horizon sweep, and does not prevent discovery of a later agency's remaining secret.
